chunks: And it was narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام that he said:
Prostration upon the earth is an obligation, and upon other than the earth is a sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground as the proper surface of prostration
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: a sunnah (prophetic tradition) designation in this legal context

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about performing sajdah on the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the proper surface for sajdah in salat. It indicates that performing prostration on the earth holds the obligatory basis, while prostration on something other than the earth is treated as sunnah (prophetic tradition).
